identity.ethnicity_appearance: Latina / Mediterranean, fair skin with warm olive undertone
identity.face_shape: oval-to-heart, gently tapering to a small soft chin — NOT round, NOT ball-shaped, NOT chubby inflated cheeks
identity.cheekbones: softly defined, natural fullness without round balloon cheeks
identity.chin: small, soft, slightly recessed in profile

skin.tone: fair to light-medium, warm olive/golden undertone
skin.texture: natural photographic skin, visible pores, believable — no plastic airbrush
skin.freckles: many natural freckles across the nose bridge and upper cheeks (must remain visible through makeup)
skin.moles: small beauty marks on cheeks and near jaw as in reference
skin.under_eyes: very light natural shadow, not heavy

eyes.color: hazel-green with amber/gold center around the pupil — never flat dark brown
eyes.shape: almond, medium-large, slight natural asymmetry ok
eyes.lashes: long, curled, wispy voluminous lashes (soft glam extensions look)
eyes.brows: thick, dark, dense, soft high arch, well groomed

nose.shape: straight refined bridge, soft rounded tip, medium-small
nose.piercing: small thin gold hoop in the left nostril (her left)

lips.size: naturally full but NOT oversized, NOT inflated, NOT duck lips
lips.shape: compact mouth width, lower lip slightly fuller than upper, soft rounded cupid's bow, strong but realistic forward projection
lips.color: nude-rose / peachy-mauve satin or soft gloss

hair.style_for_website: very long jet-black hair, straight with slight wave, middle part, below chest (matching evelyn-face-ref-long-hair-pro.jpg)
hair.do_not_use_for_finals: short pixie natural hair unless explicitly requested

makeup.level: soft glam professional — polished fashionista, still photographic and believable
makeup.base: luminous dewy skin, freckles still visible
makeup.eyes: champagne-bronze soft shadow, subtle soft liner, long wispy lashes
makeup.avoid: heavy contour, plastic doll skin, extreme fillers look, raw no-makeup look for finals

expression.default: warm, friendly, approachable soft smile, relaxed eyes

body.build: curvy, soft rounded shoulders — keep true proportions, do not slim face or body

wardrobe.pieces: structured taupe/cocoa blazer, cream silk blouse, soft tailored trousers optional
wardrobe.jewelry: delicate thin gold or silver necklace, gold nose hoop

brand_palette_environment.lighting: soft afternoon window light + warm brass lamp, editorial fashion photography

shots_to_generate.composition: Subject in RIGHT third; LEFT two thirds clean negative space for website headline
shots_to_generate.action: working at plain laptop with no logos, looking to camera with friendly soft smile

shots_to_generate.composition: half-body portrait, three-quarter turn, air above head
shots_to_generate.action: seated at desk, friendly soft smile to camera, blurred purple dashboard on monitor with no legible text
pointing at large screen with blurred automation flowchart, engaged friendly smile

hard_rules: Keep exact facial identity from uploaded references — do not beautify into a different person
Face must be oval-to-heart tapering to chin — never a round ball face
Lips naturally full only — never exaggerated
Hazel-green amber eyes — never plain brown
Long jet-black middle-part hair for website finals
No logos, no readable UI text, no watermarks
Photoreal editorial fashion photography — not illustration, not 3D, not Pixar
